sectionSubtitle: Estimate how many hours and financial bandwidth your team reclaims each year by replacing repetitive spreadsheet work with structured systems.

hours.label: Weekly Hours Spent on Manual Admin & Data
hours.description: Copy-pasting data, inventory logging, manual report generation, inbox triage.

rate.label: Estimated Value of Your Time
rate.description: Founder opportunity cost or blended hourly wage of staff performing admin work.

teamSize.label: People Performing Manual Tasks
teamSize.description: Number of founders, operators, or assistants bogged down by manual workflows.

metrics.efficiencyNote: Based on a conservative 65% time reduction achieved through structured Google Sheets, Apps Script automations, and standardized SOPs.

recommendations.sprintCondition: Your bottleneck is concentrated in repetitive data entry or reporting. A 1–2 week fixed sprint will eliminate the core manual friction.
recommendations.retainerCondition: Your team loses over 15 hours weekly across ongoing operations. A dedicated async partner will compound savings week after week.

footnote: No fluff formulas: Hours saved = (Weekly Hours × Team × 65% efficiency × 52 weeks). Value = Hours saved × Hourly rate.
